reviewMethod: Source-grounded manual review identified release blockers. Known findings below are examples, not an exhaustive scoring rubric or an accuracy percentage. Automated phrase checks can flag correct negative statements.
limitations: All 50-case allocations and financial facts are synthetic; only company identities come from the public portfolio.
Saved-dashboard cases use actual committed research packets and all 142 public identities with unknown weights.
Hosted snapshot and controlled runs overlapped against one staging provider. Measurements begin at HTTP request, not browser click.
Runs span several implementations. Do not aggregate their completion rate into a release pass.
Provider draft/final framing is an application contract, not native completion metadata.
